paper.title: Direct observation of atmospheric turbulence with a video-rate wide-field wavefront sensor
paper.authors: Yuduo Guo, Yuhan Hao, Sen Wan et al.

authorship: Original English task-design contracts; factual paraphrases only, no publisher assets or source text dumps.

evidence.locator: Methods Experimental set-up and data process; main L179-181; Fig. 1
evidence.fact: Camera Flare 48M30-CX, 7920 by 6004 pixels, CMOSIS 50000, 4.6 micrometre pixels, peak quantum efficiency at 525 nm. MLA diameter 69 micrometres, focal length 690 micrometres, F/10 and 15 by 15 detector pixels per microlens. PY005 five-axis stage adjusts rotation, pitch and yaw; sensor lies at MLA back focal plane.
Reported observations use the 0.8 m Tsinghua-NAOC telescope at Xinglong, with the WWS at its native image plane.
Sets 1-26 each have 1000 frames at 30 Hz and 2 ms; sets 27-28 each have 200 frames at 30 Hz and 2 ms; set 29 has 900 frames at 15 Hz and 5 ms. These are historical capture facts, not fresh schedules.

evidence.locator: Main L85-101; Extended Data Fig. 1, L486-487
evidence.fact: Pixels at corresponding microlens offsets form subaperture images. Small residual assembly errors are corrected by resize and rotation.

Intensity normalization uses 0.05-fold adaptive average pooling and 20-fold bicubic interpolation. Coarse translation uses about 20 epochs at learning rate 0.01; refinement at least 10 epochs at 0.001. Loss is evaluated in central 95 percent.

evidence.locator: Methods setup and slope-estimation, main L182-183 and L200-201; ED2
evidence.fact: ReLU MLP has hidden layers of 300 and 500 nodes. Noll modes 1-35 are estimated. Correction retains system aberration; prediction uses modes 4-35 with temporal-mean system aberration removed. Timing benchmark uses eight RTX 4090 GPUs.

Covariance scope differs between prose and caption. Fried-parameter maps are compared with contemporaneous observatory DIMM values; WWS windows are about 30 s while DIMM observations last 1-2 min. Temporal analysis uses 20-frame windows on a 1000-frame sequence; dome effects are discussed.

Specific demonstration uses 300 frames, 36 by 36 arcsec sub-FOVs and 40 pairs per angular separation. General Methods describes about 1000 frames over 30 s. Geometry: 0.8/15 m subaperture width, 31.65 degree zenith angle and 15 pupil subapertures.

Nine temporal frames are realigned, shifts are estimated relative to the fifth frame, irregular samples are merged and scattered interpolation densifies each subaperture. Turbulence supplies motion without physical scanning.
Estimated wavefronts feed incoherent synthetic-aperture reconstruction; no additional deformable mirror is used. The sequence underlying a 60 s kymograph has 900 frames at 15 Hz.

Residual ConvLSTM blocks have two layers/kernel 5/128 channels and five layers/kernel 3/32 channels, then a fully connected output. Channel normalization and MAE loss are used. First 5400 of 6000 frames train; final 600 test. Five 30 Hz inputs predict next frame about 33 ms ahead. Separate fine-tune data total 600 frames, including 540 training frames. Training uses shifted sequence targets [t-L+1,t] for inputs [t-L,t-1]; final next-frame evaluation is a distinct use.

evidence.locator: Methods L202-229; SI Table 2 PDF page 5; ED2-5,8
evidence.fact: WWS simulations include pitch, Gaussian noise, C-SHWS and plenoptic comparisons. Four numerical phase-screen layers span 0-10 km; r0 is 3.6 cm at 525 nm and zenith 0 degrees, L0 10 m, aperture 0.8 m, dimensionless central obstruction 0.3. Other outer-scale values form an ablation.
A separate approximately 2 km daytime example is physically observed at 25 Hz; exposure, frame count and detailed apparatus are absent.

Point sources are simulated with aberrations at RMS 0.5 wavelength using modes 4-35. Connected-component segmentation and centroid extraction replace coarse-to-fine slope estimation. The comparison has n=25 data points.

evidence.locator: Data/code availability, main L263-268; supplementary descriptions L524-564
evidence.fact: Demo models and subsets of raw observations are linked publicly; full datasets are on reasonable request. Two video descriptions and eight statistical workbooks are listed. Their bytes/pixels/software were not audited here.
